name: House
purpose: A home: every bed you add lets one more settler live in the village.
build: Room: 1 bed, 1 door, 1 light, 9 floor
levels: L2 2 lights, 1 storage, solid floor; L3 3 lights, 3 furnishing, 1 crafting table

name: Lodging House
purpose: A shared bunk house for up to 8 settlers.
build: Room: 4 beds, 1 door, 2 lights, 24 floor
levels: L2 4 lights, 2 storage, solid floor; L3 6 beds, 6 lights

name: Warehouse
purpose: The shared store Couriers fill and empty; higher levels manage more containers.
build: Room: 4 storage, 1 door, 2 lights, 25 floor
levels: L2 16 storage + ledger desk; L3 32 + 4 signs; L4 64 + 8 signs; L5 128 + 16 signs, 2 desks

name: Architect's Study
purpose: The Scholar's study, where your chosen research project advances.
build: Room: 1 lectern, 2 bookshelves, 1 door, 2 lights, 16 floor

name: School
purpose: With Families & School learned, newcomers arrive one trade level higher (3 in all).
build: Room: 4 bookshelves, 2 lecterns, 1 door, 2 lights, 25 floor

name: Farmhouse
purpose: Base for the Farmer, who works the fields you mark with the Work Scepter.
build: Room: 1 composter, 1 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

name: Mill
purpose: The Miller grinds wheat into flour and sugar cane into paper.
build: Room: 1 grindstone, 2 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

name: Bakery
purpose: The Baker turns wheat or flour into bread.
build: Room: 2 furnace/smoker, 1 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

name: Kitchen
purpose: The Cook turns mushrooms, potatoes and kelp into ready meals.
build: Room: 1 furnace/smoker, 1 cauldron, 2 storage, 1 door, 2 lights, 20 floor

name: Dining Hall
purpose: Settlers gather here at mealtime; it cuts the recruit price and the Mayor swap feast.
build: Room: 1 campfire, 1 storage, 1 door, 3 lights, 36 floor

name: Pasture
purpose: A paddock you stock with animals; the Herder shears, breeds and collects eggs.
build: Room: 2 hay bales, 1 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 25 floor

name: Butcher
purpose: The Butcher cooks raw meat and cures rabbit into Cured Hide.
build: Room: 1 smoker, 2 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

purpose: A shore post where the Fisher fishes from a chair and racks the catch.
build: Room: 20 connected water, 1 fisher's chair, 1 fish rack, 1 barrel, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

name: Hunter's Lodge
purpose: The Hunter's base: game is hunted nearby and butchered here.
build: Room: 1 fletching table, 1 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

name: Brewery
purpose: The Brewer makes malt and ale from wheat.
build: Room: 1 brewing stand, 1 cauldron, 2 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

name: Tavern
purpose: The Innkeeper serves ale and food here; travellers visit and can be recruited.
build: Room: 1 bell, 2 storage, 1 ale tap, 1 door, 3 lights, 36 floor

purpose: While a valid Well House stands, every settler with a bed gets +2 morale.
build: Yard or room: 4 water, 1 door, 1 light, 9 floor

purpose: Base for the Lumberer, who fells trees in the area you mark.
build: Yard or room: 1 crafting table, 1 storage, 1 door, 1 light, 16 floor

purpose: The Sawyer turns logs into planks and Timber Beams.

purpose: The Carpenter makes sticks, barrels and ladders.

name: Smithy
purpose: The Smith forges ingots and iron tools and swords.

purpose: The Mason cuts cobblestone into stone and stone bricks.

purpose: Makes every research project 25% cheaper in materials.
